metadata.title: Pertuzumab, Trastuzumab and Weekly Paclitaxel - 21 day
metadata.indication: HER2-positive metastatic or unresectable locally recurrent breast cancer
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Independent weekly paclitaxel rules may be assessed from a single supplied value; dose and duration inputs refine but do not suppress immediate hold findings.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

source_monitoring.echo_baseline: LVEF assessment before starting HER2-directed treatment; see specific source wording.
source_monitoring.echo_ongoing: ECHO/MUGA every 12 weeks and at completion; consider every 4–8 weeks if cardiac impairment.
source_monitoring.timing_caveat: Cycle 1 is baseline. Later cycle landmarks assume uninterrupted 21-day cycles; elapsed 12-week intervals govern after delays.
source_monitoring.disease_imaging: Individual treatment plan and consultant direction; no universal fixed CT interval in these regimen PDFs.
source_monitoring.other_pathways: DEXA may be indicated by a separate endocrine/ovarian-suppression pathway, not automatically by this HER2 regimen.
source_monitoring.bloods_regular: Before each cycle per source; weekly-day checks follow local delivery policy, not an explicit universal q7 source statement.
source_monitoring.echo_weekly_landmark: 12 weeks aligns approximately with 13th weekly paclitaxel visit if uninterrupted.

metadata.schedule_summary: Paclitaxel on Days 1, 8 and 15 of each 21-day block, for up to eight cycles; IV pertuzumab and trastuzumab on Day 1. This NCCP alternative applies when docetaxel is unsuitable, not tolerated or caused significant toxicity. Antibodies may continue after the taxane stops while beneficial and tolerated.
metadata.dose_level_context: Paclitaxel source reduction ladder 80 / 65 / 50 mg/m². The toxicity-specific action determines whether it applies; neuropathy and hepatic instructions differ.

clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the current NCCP source. It does not replace the NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review or pharmacy verification.

indications.description: First-line treatment of adults with HER2-positive metastatic or locally recurrent unresectable breast cancer who have not received previous anti-HER2 therapy or chemotherapy for metastatic disease, where docetaxel is unsuitable, not tolerated or has caused significant toxicity.

renal_input.reason: Retain exact measured creatinine clearance so decimal gaps between the source bands are surfaced for review rather than rounded into a dose band.

action.recommendation: A documented ANC <0.5 episode lasting at least seven days requires one dose-level reduction after recovery (80 →65 →50 mg/m²), even if current ANC has recovered. Verify actual dose and recovery before restarting.

action.recommendation: Establish whether this low baseline value is an initiation result or historical. Obtain the current LVEF and treatment stage; no automatic ongoing hold can be based on an old result alone.

action.recommendation: Interrupt the implicated infusion and assess/manage the reaction under the local emergency policy. Confirm culprit medicine and severity before any restart; a prior resolved reaction is not the same as a current reaction.
